source_reported_experiments.study_design: After tamoxifen-induced kidney-specific Pkd1 deletion, mice were randomized after weaning to untreated, salsalate, tolvaptan-SD or combination arms; tolvaptan-SD vs untreated is separately evaluated. Figure 1 and Methods/Results inspected.
source_reported_experiments.design_basis: Randomized assigned treatment within a conditional Pkd1 disease model supports causal treatment comparison. Source prose says tolvaptan monotherapy reduced cystic index, but Figure 1D labels tolvaptan vs KO p=0.19; preserve figure-level non-significant cyst-index contrast rather than repeat the prose implication.
source_reported_experiments.disease_stage: Tamoxifen at P18/P19; treatment started P40; endpoint was individual failure/survival or common study sacrifice when about 75% untreated mutants reached ESRD, approximately 111–120 days in study protocol.

model.disease_relevance: ADPKD-relevant Pkd1 disease genotype; mouse kidney disease, not human patient response.

source_reported_experiments.perturbation: Tolvaptan-SD monotherapy vs untreated mutant controls; separate salsalate and combination arms not pooled.
source_reported_experiments.context: Tolvaptan-SD chow formulation containing 66.7% tolvaptan; 0.15% formulation in food, described by authors as equivalent to commonly used 0.1% tolvaptan chow. Tamoxifen-induced disease.
source_reported_experiments.temporal_order: Tamoxifen at P18 and P19; randomized after weaning; assigned diet started P40; BU monitoring from P75; endpoint-triggered sacrifices and common sacrifice when ~75% untreated group reached ESRD.

denominator.as_reported: TOL n=19; untreated KO n=22; all mutant mice with and without ESRD included in panels B–E

denominator.endpoint: cystic index: cystic area / total kidney area at endpoint

source_reported_experiments.repeated_measures_or_pseudoreplication: BU measured weekly from P75 with increased frequency as required; repeated measures within mouse are not independent. Survival is animal-level. Endpoint kidney measures use one animal-level measurement; Figure 1F images are representative median sections, not biological replicates.
source_reported_experiments.assay: Kaplan–Meier kidney survival; kidney weight/body-weight ratio; cystic index from PAS histology; blood urea. Figure 1 includes protocol and representative kidney sections.
source_reported_experiments.timepoint: Individual endpoint; untreated failure monitoring and common sacrifice near 111–120 days; kidney endpoints assessed at each animal endpoint.
source_reported_experiments.endpoint: Kidney survival and structural disease measures (2KW/BW and cystic index); source-reported Figure 1 outcomes.

effect.estimate: Tolvaptan-SD vs untreated: kidney survival improved (Fig. 1B, p<0.01 symbol); 2KW/BW lower (Fig. 1C, p<0.01); cystic index contrast labeled p=0.19 (not significant; Fig. 1D); blood urea lower (Fig. 1E, p<0.05).
effect.unit: days to ESRD; 2KW/BW%; percent cystic area; blood urea mmol/L
effect.uncertainty: Source reports significance symbols; no numeric effect or interval transcribed. Figure 1D conflicts with broad Results prose describing cystic index reduction; panel-specific p=0.19 retained as the direct contrast. Combination vs monotherapy differences are reported not significant.

confirmation.exposure_or_perturbation: Assigned tolvaptan-SD diet; authors report food pellet formulation; no individual exposure measurements shown here.
confirmation.amount: 0.15% tolvaptan-SD formulation in food (66.7% tolvaptan); authors describe equivalence to commonly used 0.1% tolvaptan chow; individual mg/kg exposure not supplied.
confirmation.localization: Oral systemic delivery; kidney receptor occupancy/localization not measured.
confirmation.function: Separate tissue protein and phosphorylation assays reported treatment-associated signaling changes, but these do not substitute for the animal outcomes; no AVPR2-specific genetic control.

translation_limits: Tolvaptan-SD is a formulation designed to improve oral bioavailability, not shown identical to marketed formulation/exposure.
Male mouse, conditional Pkd1 model; tamoxifen induction at P18/P19.
Animal survival improved, but cystic-index comparison is not significant in Figure 1D (p=0.19), despite broad prose statement.
Variable endpoint timing and repeated BU monitoring; figure panels include animals with/without ESRD.
Salsalate combination is a distinct arm; authors report no significant combination-vs-monotherapy difference.
Animal disease outcome cannot establish human patient efficacy.
Authors thank Otsuka Pharmaceuticals for providing tolvaptan-SD; this material contribution is disclosed.

source_reported_experiments.study_design: Controlled AVP and tolvaptan titration in primary ADPKD epithelial cultures; separate 72-hour MTT proxy assay, reported source result.
source_reported_experiments.design_basis: Within-culture ligand and antagonist comparisons; MTT is metabolic readout and high-dose basal suppression limits specific proliferation interpretation.
source_reported_experiments.perturbation: AVP challenge with tolvaptan dose series
source_reported_experiments.context: 72-hour exposure; basal high-dose MTT suppression in separate no-AVP panel
source_reported_experiments.repeated_measures_or_pseudoreplication: Preparation is independent biological unit; wells are nested technical measures.
source_reported_experiments.assay: MTT metabolic activity assay, used by source as proliferation proxy
source_reported_experiments.endpoint: MTT signal, not direct cell count

effect.estimate: AVP increased ADPKD-culture readout 52% over control; tolvaptan reduced AVP-associated increment by 30% and 43% at 10^-10 and 10^-9 M (P<0.05 and P<0.001), while 10^-8 M blocked it.
effect.uncertainty: Source-reported percentages and significance; no interval transcribed.

confirmation.exposure_or_perturbation: AVP and tolvaptan added in vitro
confirmation.function: MTT metabolic proxy only; separate cAMP studies are not confirmation within this endpoint.

translation_limits: MTT is not direct cell proliferation/cell count
Small donor/preparation denominator
High-dose basal signal suppression leaves nonspecific effects
No receptor-specific loss/re-expression in assay
In-vitro exposure not oral dose or clinical phenotype

interpretation_limit: Bulk whole-kidney transcript levels do not measure receptor occupancy, cAMP/protein phosphorylation, cellular composition, cyst area/volume, or renal function.
